steps.title: Move
steps.instruction: Use WASD to move and confirm the movement indicator changes.
steps.unavailableReason: Movement input is not available until the role is ready.

steps.title: Target
steps.instruction: Place the cursor over the Civilian to show the target and interaction preview.
steps.unavailableReason: No valid target is currently focused.

steps.title: Attack
steps.instruction: Press the primary attack once and wait for the authoritative result.
steps.unavailableReason: Attack is unavailable while the player is dead, reloading, or not role-ready.

steps.title: Interact
steps.instruction: Select the visible interaction option and activate it.
steps.unavailableReason: The focused target has no enabled interaction option.

steps.title: Trade
steps.instruction: Open the merchant and buy one health potion when the wallet and stock allow it.
steps.completionPredicate: atomic purchase success with wallet and inventory revisions
steps.unavailableReason: Trade requires an active merchant, range, line of sight, funds, inventory space, and stock.

steps.title: Save and reconnect
steps.instruction: Complete a save, reconnect, and verify the restored authoritative state.
steps.unavailableReason: Reconnect validation is unavailable until the server has committed a checkpoint.
